text: Licence MC-TR70722 appears on credentials held by two doctors, Dr. Heather Hester and Dr. Carrie Lozano, both recorded with the Medical Council of Turkey and both actively billing. Two-holder collisions on one number do occur honestly in this data — issuing-country number formats collide — which is exactly why this scores low rather than high. The same-council concentration keeps it from being dismissed outright: a within-registry duplicate is likelier to be one record cloned than two coincidentally identical numbers. There is no billing anomaly on either identity to corroborate laundering. Next step: a registry lookup on MC-TR70722; if both records are genuinely issued, dismiss as a format collision.
